title: Slice-and-trim: sprint filtering & quick wins (Aug 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This doc captures the sprint-level filtering and cut decisions for Console & Tooling UX work to be considered for Sprint 22 (2026-08-10 -> 2026-08-23). Goal: reduce scope to a focused set of engineering-backed items that deliver observable metrics improvement (time-to-task, support tickets reduced) and unblock a follow-on mid-sprint proof-of-concept for a new filtered backlog UI.

Context / constraints:
- Infra window: limited frontend bandwidth next week (two engineers on on-call rotation) so anything >3d frontend work needs a clear fallback or split task.
- Analytics: we only have daily traces for route usage; add instrumentation tasks for any feature that touches route filters.
- Dependents: rollout gating for Dedicated customers requires a UX flag AND an API contract (see CONSOLE-431).

Sprint outcome measures (primary):
- Reduce time-to-find-route (measured via user flow funnels) by 15% for users who hit the route list.
- Decrease backlog triage time per ticket by 20% for product managers using the filtered view.
- Ship 2 quick-win items with <5d total dev effort each.

Attendees (triage session 2026-08-05):
- Aisha Patel (owner, product)
- Evan Chen (PM/analytics)
- Marisol Rivera (design)
- Jonah Kline (eng frontend)
- Priya Desai (sre - availability constraints)

Decision framework used:
- Must fix: user-impact + safety/regulatory requirement (non-negotiable)
- Quick-win: <5 dev days + measurable metric impact
- Research spike: exploratory, must be timeboxed and have concrete success criteria

Backlog candidates reviewed (short notes + decision):
1) CONSOLE-412: route-list multiselect filters (tag, model, environment)
- Notes: large UX surface, needs API filter endpoint already partially implemented by infra. Design has wireframes. Potential for big metric gain.
- Estimate: frontend 6d, backend 4d -> total 10d
- Decision: defer to next sprint unless split into quick-win subset. Action: split into (a) server-side tag filter API (CONSOLE-431 subtask) and (b) client-side minimal filter pill (quick-win).

2) CONSOLE-450: inline route rename + lightweight validation
- Notes: frequent support asks for rename mistakes; customers request preventing collisions. Low visual impact but high support ROI.
- Estimate: frontend 2d, backend 1d
- Decision: accept as quick-win; assign to Jonah + small backend refactor. Owner: Jonah. Jira: CONSOLE-450 -> ready.

3) CONSOLE-439: compact route card density mode (wireframes by Marisol)
- Notes: reduces vertical scroll; moderate engineering but mostly CSS/layout. Risk: accessibility regressions flagged.
- Estimate: 3d frontend + a11y review 1d
- Decision: accept as quick-win but requires a11y checklist before merge. Owner: Marisol + Jonah. Tag: needs a11y.

4) CONSOLE-402: rollout analytics hooks for rollout page (track per-rollout conversion)
- Notes: backend events missing; necessary for SLO-based rollouts and auto-fallback metrics. High value for product decisions but backend work is non-trivial.
- Estimate: backend 6d, infra 2d
- Decision: mark as research & staging-only spike this sprint (3d) to prototype event spec. Owner: Evan. Output: event schema + sample queries.

5) CONSOLE-467: keyboard navigation improvements for action menus
- Notes: small polish; accessibility win.
- Estimate: 1d
- Decision: accept as quick-win. Owner: front-end buddy team.

Cut list (explicit items to trim this sprint):
- Full feature for advanced multiselect filters (leave only pill + server filter spike). Rationale: too big for available dev capacity.
- Route tagging bulk-editing flow. Rationale: downstream API dependency and more UX polish needed.
- Direct integration of embedded playbooks into rollout detail pane. Rationale: large scope and not on A/B measurement path this sprint.

Wireframe / UX notes (Marisol):
- Minimal filter pill pattern: small dropdown with recent filters and an inline search; should avoid heavy modal interactions. Pilot only tag and environment filters (model filter deferred).
- Rename inline: show ephemeral validation message on collision with a one-click revert. Keep undo window 10s.
- Compact route card: show truncated description + keyword chip; expand on hover or keyboard focus. Need to preserve semantic DOM order for screen readers.

Open questions / blockers:
- API contract for server-side filter: who owns schema? (engineering + product to sync 2026-08-06). Estimated: infra change needs rollout plan to avoid tenant impact.
- Analytics event taxonomy: do we route events through existing metrics pipeline or add a parallel debug stream? (Decision needed by end of spike).
- Accessibility signoff: which a11y reviewer is available this sprint? (Priya to coordinate).

Owners and immediate next actions (by 2026-08-09):
- Jonah: pick up CONSOLE-450 (rename) and CONSOLE-467 (keyboard nav). Create PR for quick rename validation.
- Evan: prototype event schema for CONSOLE-402 spike and share sample queries; raise any infra blocking ticket.
- Marisol: deliver mockups for minimal filter pill + compact card states, include CSS token suggestions.
- Aisha: create split task list for CONSOLE-412 and open API subtask for infra. Ensure progress is tracked in the sprint board.

Acceptance criteria (for items accepted this sprint):
- CONSOLE-450: route rename must persist and perform collision check; unit tests + e2e flow for happy + collision cases; metric: reduce rename-related support chats by measurable count (tracked via tags).
- CONSOLE-439: compact card mode toggled via settings; a11y checklist complete; performance regression <5% on route-list render time.
- CONSOLE-467: keyboard nav meets WCAG AA for focus order and visible focus indicator.

Notes to reviewers / TODOs:
- Add Jira tasks for split pieces of CONSOLE-412 before sprint start.
- Evan to add instrumentation ticket for filter usage to tie back to outcome measure.
- Marisol to attach final Figma frame links in the Jira tickets.

Appendix (quick rough estimation table):
- CONSOLE-450: 3 dev days total -> priority: high (quick-win)
- CONSOLE-467: 1 dev day -> priority: high (quick-win)
- CONSOLE-439: 4 dev days -> priority: medium (quick-win + a11y)
- CONSOLE-402 (spike): 3 dev days -> priority: research
- CONSOLE-412 (split): server filter API 3d, UI pill 2d -> schedule as two subtasks

End of doc.
